sections.heading: Connect an AI model to chat
paragraphs: Miggi is free. You need your own OpenAI API key with available credits, or a compatible local model through Ollama. Cloud API usage is billed separately.
Choose a cloud or local connection. AI replies are unavailable until a model is configured.

sections.heading: Run a local model with Ollama
paragraphs: Install Ollama from its official website and download a model suitable for your computer. Ollama is installed separately from Miggi.
Start the local Ollama server. In Miggi’s AI settings, choose Ollama, the local connection, and a compatible model; verify and apply your selection.

Local inference needs no cloud API key. Speed, memory use, and quality depend on your computer and model; not every model supports Miggi’s requirements. Do not expose the server to the internet to connect it.
Available tools depend on the connection. A local model does not make network features offline; Ollama cloud models are a separate mode not covered here.
